name: Yasashii Ame ~Hitotsu no Kasa ni wa Futari Made Shika Hairenai~
original_name: やさしい雨 ～ひとつの傘にはふたりまでしか入れない～
source:
Hero was a promising cameraman three years ago, but he lost in the harsh profession competition. One day he was delivering photos to a magazine as assistant photographer when the rain suddenly started. He saw a girl hiding from the rain and his dulled vision started to shine as brightly as ever.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
三年前，英雄是一位很有前途的摄影师，但他在残酷的职业竞争中落败。有一天，他作为助理摄影师正在给一家杂志社送照片，突然下起了雨。他看到了一个躲雨的女孩，他呆滞的视线开始变得明亮起来。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
